claim_summaries.claim: In a finite weakly reversible network, a directed path inside a linkage class transports a complex y to z with a fixed nonnegative spectator x-y; the endpoint x-y+z lies in the same stochastic communicating class and does not increase the exact available-source factorial potential F when y maximizes the source falling factorial.

A deterministic coordinate face is non-invariant exactly when a source-supported-in-face reaction creates a missing species; from a lattice state with all present counts above source thresholds, that reaction is enabled and strictly enlarges support within the same communicating class.
The route and endpoint potential inequality do not establish repeated thin-boundary recovery, negative Foster drift, finite stationary mass, or classwise positive recurrence.
